# Vendored HPy 0.9.0 headers

This directory contains the unmodified `hpy/devel/include` tree from the
official `hpy-0.9.0.tar.gz` source distribution published on PyPI.

- Version/tag: `0.9.0`
- Source SHA-256:
  `4545310f3a7f9ac249c0f19a80a9b05f46565afb62b7e9225b79493b7b6c70cc`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/hpyproject/hpy/tree/0.9.0>
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The headers are test/build inputs for Universal ABI extensions and the
authoritative layout oracle for Tonic's adapter. Tonic does not compile or link
HPy's CPython runtime implementation.
